def test_an_edge_with_no_affirmed_hash_is_pending() -> None:
    """
    :verifies: SEG-SREQ-016
    :test-id: SEG-TS-005
    """
    claimed = EdgeRecord("a", "b", "Refines", LinkState.DIRECTLY_OUTDATED)
    built = build(Source([requirement("a"), requirement("b")], [claimed]))
    assert built.edges[0].state is LinkState.PENDING
